description:
Outcome: Members browse seven-day availability, book a court, view their own upcoming bookings and cancel, from README and owner setup answers.
Scope: Accessible server-rendered Django forms/pages, court/date navigation, confirmation, integration with T-005/T-006/T-007 and no alternate unvalidated write path. Excludes: public API, guest payment, recurring bookings and production deployment.
Acceptance: Signed-in members complete the whole journey and see updated availability and remaining allowance; no identifying details of other members are exposed.
Behaviour: Empty availability/bookings, clear form errors, submitting feedback, stale-slot conflict recovery, cutoff explanations, keyboard operation and correct focus/error association.
Verification: Django request/integration tests and browser walkthrough on narrow and wide screens. Prerequisites: T-004, T-006 and T-007. Assumptions: Django templates; availability is visible without disclosing other member details.
title: Accessible booking and cancellation website
